high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene of a traditional building with architectural elements reminiscent of Indian architecture, possibly a palace or a temple. The building is painted in a light beige color with intricate white decorative patterns along the roofline. The roof features a series of small, pointed arches that add to the ornate design. A peacock stands prominently on the roof of the building, adding a touch of nature to the man-made structure.
